newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU cuts maize, sorghum import tariffs to Spain.
newsitem.headline: EU cuts maize, sorghum import tariffs to Spain.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday awarded a tariff cut of 60.98 Ecus per tonne for imports of 56,000 tonnes of non-EU maize to Spain, member-country officials.
It also cut by 37.98 Ecus per tonne the tariff on imports of 70,000 tonnes of non-EU sorghum to Spain.
The EU's grain panel in Brussels, however, rejected all bids for the preferential import of non-EU maize into Portugal, they said.

Importers had placed bids for the import of 1.225 million tonnes of non-EU maize into Portugal while the EU had opened a tender for the import of only 350,000 tonnes of maize into the southern European country.
